endpoints:
  - name: syn02
    group: hosts
    url: "icmp://192.168.1.31"
    interval: 60s
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions: ["[CONNECTED] == true"]

  - name: glances syn02
    group: hosts
    url: "http://192.168.1.31:61208/api/4/quicklook"
    interval: 120s
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "[BODY].mem > 0"

  - name: pi-zwave01
